# Naveen (NAV) — Senior Colorist

> Naveen, known as NAV (@coloristnav), is a filmmaker and Senior Colorist at Figureout Post, based in India and working worldwide as a freelance/remote colourist. He colour grades music videos, commercials and brand films, and feature and short films in DaVinci Resolve. He also teaches colour grading at Master Color Academy.

## Notable work
- Champagini — music video for Asal Kolaar (Think Indie), directed by Dinesu, DOP AJ Tippu
- Sigma Paiyan — music video for Asal Kolaar (Think Music / Think Indie)
- 170CM — music video for Paal Dabba
- 7 MSD and Gumbal Kulla Naan — music videos for Sokku (7VG Production); Gumbal reel reached 112,954 likes on Instagram
- Titan commercial featuring Kalyani Priyadarshan (Burp Productions, directed by Akshay KP)
- Regal Jewellers commercial (Geometry Artists)
- Echos Above — Happily Never After, Episodes 01-03
- Doc Sneakers commercial
- The 38th House on the Left — Irish feature film, screened at the Irish Film Institute, Dublin
- Be By Your Side — music video for Pillow Queens (Ireland)
- See / Sleep — music video for Barnburner, colour grade by Naveen
- BEGGIN — short film, Film Shortage Best Pick of the Month

## Services
- Colour grading / DI for music videos
- Colour grading for commercials and brand films
- Colour grading for feature and short films
- Remote colour grading worldwide
- Look development and pre-production colour consultation
- Teaching: Master Color Academy — DaVinci Resolve, beginner to high-end professional workflows, online, offline and 1:1 (DM "COLOR" on Instagram to start)

- Spec and portfolio concept work (for example Guinness, Strava, Adidas x Foot Locker, Tesla, Cupra x GQ, Calvin Klein spec) is shown on his Behance as portfolio/spec work and is not presented as client commissions.
